script:
#!/bin/bash
set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/_xm_front_sync
echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/e92b86d028add49ed0623b22b7f07639a7617272/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js?ref=e92b86d028add49ed0623b22b7f07639a7617272' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || { echo '下载失败: assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '0a65bca1312f73d3e619359a77da1113fe5a657eeda06930db061d723319f923' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=0a65bca1312f73d3e619359a77da1113fe5a657eeda06930db061d723319f923"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'
echo '=== 同步 assets/css/memory-graph.css ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/0222785b9ee7088a9f8063fae3724b72cb049ac6/assets/css/memory-graph.css' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/css/memory-graph.css?ref=0222785b9ee7088a9f8063fae3724b72cb049ac6' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || { echo '下载失败: assets/css/memory-graph.css'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '93a74c657f61dc32477614e0ca5fa3410be3686e5713e94c246f60c67f9b6056' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=93a74c657f61dc32477614e0ca5fa3410be3686e5713e94c246f60c67f9b6056"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css'
rm -rf /tmp/_xm_front_sync
